title: Bobkov two-point inequality
statement:
Let $a,b\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $a+b\in[0,1]$ and $a-b\in[0,1]$. Then the closed Gaussian profile satisfies
\[
U(a)\le \frac{\sqrt{U(a+b)^2+b^2}+\sqrt{U(a-b)^2+b^2}}{2}.
\]
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. For real $a,b$ with $a+b,a-b\in[0,1]$, $\overline I(a)\le\bigl(\sqrt{\overline I(a+b)^2+b^2}+\sqrt{\overline I(a-b)^2+b^2}\bigr)/2$.
